about_text:
WEM Labeler v1.5 (WPF)

A tool for labeling missing WEM audio files
Uses vgmstream for real-time audio preview

Supports CSV with WemRes/Banks/WwiseID source info
Config file: config.json
Supports Chinese/English switching

Built-in audio pipeline (Tools menu, migrated from the Python scripts):
  ① Extract BNK from BankRes
  ② Build audio mapping  ③ Export audio from mapping
  Export by Event ID / Analyze unused WEMs

Shortcuts:
  ↑ ↓    Prev/Next file (auto-save)
  Space  Play/Stop audio
  Ctrl+T Play the txtp owning the current WEM
  Ctrl+S Save current label
  Enter  Save when in the label box
